text.lead: The Situation is a 2006 American war drama film directed by Philip Haas and starring Connie Nielsen. It was produced by Liaquat Ahamed, a Pulitzer Prize-winning author.
text.plot: The film plays out against the backdrop of the 2003 Iraq War, where an American journalist (who happens to be in a love triangle between a CIA operative and an Iraqi photographer) is collecting material to write a meaningful story.
text.cast:
- Connie Nielsen as Anna Molyneux
- Damian Lewis as Dan Murphy
- Mido Hamada as Zaid
- John Slattery as Colonel Carrick
- Tom McCarthy as Major Hanks
- Shaun Evans as Wesley
